newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Sept 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Phone calls and messages from well-wishers pour in for UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan, after his surgery in the United States.
- UAE electricity minister Hamid Nasser al-Oweiss says there is no intention to raise electricity fees.
- Electricity projects to require up to 800 million dirhams in 1997, according to the ministry's budget.
- Cargo ship to take amnesty seekers out of the United Arab Emirates to India is expected to arrive in Dubai today.

- Water conservation is focus of Big 5 Exhibition which opened in Dubai on Sunday. The UAE's water and electricity minister said that the Gulf region must understand the technical developments in this crucial sector.
Estimates put investments into developing the region's water resources at 13 billion dirhams over the next 25 years.
- UAE and other Gulf Arab states are pressing ahead with plans to link their power grids, UAE minister Oweiss says.
